title: 同量不同答：语言模型中的数值表示不变性研究
summary: 该研究生成3600个精确有理数问题和8600个提示，涵盖五种保持数值恒等的变换，评估五个开源模型。发现规范准确率高达0.969-0.996，但轨道不变性降至0.851-0.981，主要因科学计数法超出解析语法，揭示评估接口可伪装成推理失败。
summary_en: This study generates 3,600 exact-rational problems and 8,600 prompts across five identity-preserving transformations, evaluating five open-weight models. Canonical accuracy reaches 0.969-0.996, but orbit invariance drops to 0.851-0.981, largely because scientific notation falls outside the parser grammar, showing evaluator interfaces can masquerade as reasoning failures.
